categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Conant Optical Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a resin spectacle lens product and service provider. Its product portfolio includes standardized lenses, customized lenses with personalized and high-end features, and multifunctional lenses. The company also engages in the development and manufacturing of lenses and vision solutions for smart glasses and XR headsets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced automated production equipment across its three production bases in Shanghai, Jiangsu (China), and Sabae (Japan) to manufacture resin spectacle lenses. It focuses on continuous upgrading of automation to improve efficiency and reduce wastage. The R&D efforts include developing superimposed and innovative lenses with different refraction indices and functions, as well as extended reality (XR) technologies including AR and AI glasses.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad network of customers worldwide, including renowned spectacle lens brand owners and international ophthalmic optic companies. Its products are sold to over 90 countries, with key markets including Mainland China, the United States, Japan, India, Australia, Thailand, Germany, Brazil, and other regions. The customer base spans ophthalmic optics and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanghai Conant Optical operates primarily in Mainland China, Japan, Thailand, and the United States, with sales distributed across Asia, the Americas, Europe, Oceania, and Africa. Its production facilities are located in Shanghai and Jiangsu in China, and Sabae in Japan. The company also has investment projects in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the optical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying resin spectacle lenses and related optical products. It also provides end-to-end services including customized lens solutions and is expanding into downstream applications such as smart glasses and XR devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing production capacity and automation, strengthening R&D capabilities with national-level centers including XR R&D, and developing innovative lens products. The company is actively investing in smart glasses and XR headset technologies, collaborating with global technology and consumer electronics companies. It also focuses on expanding its customer base and brand promotion in the domestic market.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sales of resin spectacle lenses, including multifunctional, standardized, and customized lenses. The company also derives income from government grants and plans to expand revenue streams through new product lines in smart glasses and XR vision solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Shanghai Conant Optical positions itself as a leading spectacle lens product and service provider in China and globally. It competes by offering a broad product range, high-quality customized lenses, and advanced manufacturing capabilities, aiming to be one of the world's most prominent providers in the optical lens industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue growth of 17.1% from RMB1,759.6 million in 2023 to RMB2,060.8 million in 2024, with profit increasing by 31.0% to RMB428.3 million. Production volume grew 15.1% year-on-year to 208.6 million pieces. Total assets increased by 20.4% to RMB2,388.8 million, with a workforce of 2,723 employees across China, Japan, and the USA.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Conant Optical emphasizes high-quality, personalized, and customized resin spectacle lenses with differentiated and high-end features. Its competitive advantages include advanced automated production, extensive R&D capabilities especially in XR technologies, a broad global customer network, and integrated end-to-end optical solutions including collaboration with hospitals for ophthalmology services.
